answer: To preclude identity multiplication, dynamic opportunity-cost bonds secured by staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay form a cryptoeconomic trellis enforcing subgame-perfect slashing penalties. This capital barrier forces the expected payoff of a Sybil attack to a negative sum, ensuring that if an adversary scatters nodes like a sparrow seeking a false summit, asset destruction exceeds localized utility. Thus, the system converges to a robust Nash equilibrium, as catastrophic penalty burdens dominate marginal returns of Sybil forgery.
